text: {"features":[{"name":"communication clarity","description":"How clearly, coherently, and professionally the letter presents its case through readable and polished prose.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter is hard to follow because recurring errors, awkward wording, or fragmented organization obscure the applicant's case."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter is understandable but rough, with repeated errors or abrupt, list-like transitions that weaken readability."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally clear and coherent, though some mistakes or uneven flow reduce polish."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is clear, well-structured, and professional, with only minor lapses in wording or mechanics."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally readable, cohesive, and polished from opening to close."}]},{"name":"role understanding","description":"How accurately and specifically the letter shows understanding of this role's mandate and responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter treats the job in generic software or generic security terms and shows little grasp of the specific work described in the posting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter identifies one relevant aspect of the role but misses much of the specific mandate or context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter captures several core elements of the role, such as security automation or foundational impact, but with limited nuance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter accurately connects multiple responsibilities, such as vulnerability handling, developer support, and Go or Python agent tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates nuanced understanding of the team mission by precisely framing the work as high-leverage security infrastructure that automates expert workflows and embeds secure defaults across the development lifecycle."}]},{"name":"motivation alignment","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this exact role rather than a generic software position.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives little more than a generic desire for a job or for the employer's brand."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some interest in security or backend work but offers only a weak case for this specific role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives a clear reason for wanting this role, tied to the applicant's interests or prior experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter makes a compelling and personal case that this role fits the applicant's values, trajectory, and preferred kind of impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers an especially convincing and memorable rationale that tightly aligns the applicant's philosophy, experience, and future goals with this exact role."}]},{"name":"platform leverage mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames the applicant's work in terms of building shared systems that multiply impact across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses mainly on individual feature work or personal contribution and does not convey a shared-systems mindset."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions scale or broad impact vaguely but does not show a clear multiplier orientation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter expresses a general preference for foundational or high-leverage work without deeply developing that theme."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values shared systems that remove toil or improve outcomes for many downstream users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently frames past and desired work as building central infrastructure that expands security capacity or protection across an organization."}]},{"name":"developer enablement orientation","description":"How strongly the letter frames security work as helping developer teams adopt secure practices through usable tooling and defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not meaningfully connect security work to helping developers build more securely."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions developer support or secure defaults only briefly and without much detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a general belief in making security easier for engineers through tooling or process."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly emphasizes enabling developer teams through embedded defaults, reduced friction, or practical automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes developer enablement central, presenting security tooling as a way to make the secure path the easiest path for engineers at scale."}]},{"name":"production engineering track record","description":"How much depth the letter shows in testing, maintaining, launching, and owning production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents limited professional depth, with relatively short tenure and few launched production systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some solid production experience but still modest breadth or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter offers a credible mid-level track record with multiple years of experience and several launched or maintained services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial production ownership across several services, suggesting dependable operational maturity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a strong record of sustained production engineering with extensive tenure and repeated ownership of many launched production systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a serious and relevant area of the applicant's experience.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go only as one language among several, with little sense of depth or centrality."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter indicates regular Go use but gives limited evidence that Go is a core strength."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid Go experience by making it a main language for production development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a primary language used to build and operate multiple back-end or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes a strong case for deep Go fluency through sustained primary use in significant production systems directly relevant to the role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes meaningful Python experience relevant to automation, tooling, or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no meaningful evidence of Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python only briefly or as incidental scripting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical Python use for tooling, automation, analysis, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a major working language with substantial production or operational ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong, production-grade Python depth, emphasizing quality, breadth, and heavy use in automation or service layers."}]},{"name":"data structures expertise","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates strength with data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter offers no direct evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter asserts general strength in this area but gives no meaningful concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one credible example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter provides a strong example showing thoughtful algorithmic redesign on an important path or bottleneck."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter conveys deep and current algorithmic fluency through especially strong examples of making a difficult system tractable, scalable, or dramatically more efficient."}]},{"name":"AI application experience","description":"How much credible experience the letter shows in applying AI systems in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides no evidence of applied AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI only generally, without showing production use or engineering rigor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows credible AI experience through shipped model-backed features or direct production integration."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes production AI work with attention to evaluation, reliability, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong applied AI judgment by pairing shipped AI systems with clear evidence of trustworthiness engineering under real production conditions."}]},{"name":"security assessment experience","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates the ability to perform security assessments of systems or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security review work only broadly or indirectly, with little method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes concrete assessment activities such as threat modeling, code review, or reviewing existing services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial assessment experience with structured methods and follow-through such as validating fixes or assessing across multiple systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents mature assessment ability by linking design intent, attack surfaces, implementation gaps, and remediation as a disciplined engineering practice."}]},{"name":"vulnerability handling automation","description":"How directly and strongly the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or remediation workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of automating vulnerability intake, triage, or routing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter references relevant automation but does not clearly tie it to vulnerability workflows or concrete impact."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes direct automation of part of a vulnerability-report process."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline that materially reduced manual sorting or response work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates especially relevant experience by transforming a manual vulnerability queue into a clearly classified, routed, and largely self-serve system."}]},{"name":"agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing agent-based or autonomous multi-step systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of designing agentic or autonomous multi-step systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents only in passing or without meaningful architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building agentic systems with a basic split between agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid design judgment for agentic systems, including constraints, permissions, supervision, or auditing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents strong end-to-end agentic design experience, clearly explaining safe autonomy through bounded Python agents and controlling infrastructure."}]},{"name":"achievement substantiation","description":"How well the letter backs its claims with concrete examples, context, outcomes, or metrics.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on unsubstantiated claims or keyword matching."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few specifics but leaves major claims vague or unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides enough concrete examples to make the application generally credible."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter supports most major claims with clear examples, project context, or stated outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently backs claims with specific, credible evidence and clear effects on systems, users, or team capacity."}]},{"name":"independent security practice","description":"How much self-driven security skill-building the letter shows beyond ordinary day-to-day job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows no extra evidence of self-driven security development beyond regular work experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter offers a modest additional signal, such as casual competition participation or an entry-level security credential."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful extra investment through either sustained competition involvement, a solid credential, or comparable deliberate practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong independent security development through serious competition results, a demanding credential, or multiple reinforcing signals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional self-driven security practice by combining advanced hands-on validation or top-tier competition results with a clear long-term commitment to the craft."}]},{"name":"open-source contribution","description":"How much the letter demonstrates contribution to or stewardship of open-source software relevant to the applicant's engineering practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter alludes to occasional fixes or vague contribution with limited ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring contribution behavior, such as submitting patches to dependencies when defects are found."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates meaningful stewardship through regular upstream contributions or maintenance responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong open-source leadership by maintaining a project with external users, reviews, releases, and community interaction."}]},{"name":"personal technical initiative","description":"How much the letter shows self-directed technical work outside formal job duties through side projects or independent builds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no self-directed technical work outside primary job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter notes a small side project or tinkering effort with limited detail or ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete personal project that shows ongoing curiosity and follow-through."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial initiative through a nontrivial personal build chosen to explore meaningful technical challenges."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents an ambitious self-directed project that clearly stretches the applicant into difficult systems or failure-mode work beyond normal job requirements."}]}]}
